source.name: An open disclosure-navigation dropdown must close when keyboard focus moves out of the navigation
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/NickDJM/accessible-menu/issues/354) at eb9c3a4eca7689482e4d597524c5212f70460b89. Blind to the maintainers' fix 54a3a5753771edfffc0b2b656162f415f5a0c462; routing auto.

journey.title: Tabbing out of the navigation closes the open dropdown
journey.goal: After a keyboard user leaves the navigation, the Shop dropdown no longer covers the page

steps.title: Tab out of the navigation to search

functionalJourney.title: Open the Shop dropdown with the pointer

guards.title: Escape closes the Shop dropdown and returns focus to Shop
guards.goal: Escape inside the dropdown closes it

plan.root_cause: Dropdown remains open when focus leaves the navigation via Tab because there is no listener to close the submenu when focus exits the menu.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a focusout listener to the menu element that closes any open submenu when focus moves outside the menu.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When a keyboard user tabs out of the navigation, any open dropdown will close, preventing it from covering page content.
functional_risks: May interfere with custom focus management if subclasses rely on focusout for other purposes.
If the menu contains focusable elements that intentionally keep the menu open (e.g., a button that opens a dialog), they could cause unintended closure.
verification_requirements: Tabbing from the shop button to the search input results in aria-expanded=\"false\" and #plants hidden.
Opening the dropdown via Enter and closing via Escape still works.
Tabbing within the menu (e.g., from shop to plants to tools) continues to work as expected.
